speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Community-Acquired Pneumonia

Your recent influenza infection combined with non-compliance to treatment is a significant risk factor for developing a secondary bacterial pneumonia. The presence of purulent sputum and shortness of breath strongly supports this suspicion over a simple viral illness. Please wait for the pending lab and imaging results to confirm the specific pathogen and extent of the lung involvement.
